results.prereg_data: 20 years in-sample (the sweep never sees more) + 8 years frozen holdout
results.prereg_hypothesis: A small sleeve of synthetic instruments carries positive short-lag return autocorrelation; a moving-average crossover can harvest it net of a flat cost.
results.prereg_kill_criterion: GO only if DSR >= 0.95 AND PBO < 0.50 AND holdout Sharpe > 0 — all three
results.prereg_primary_metric: annualised Sharpe ratio of the equal-weighted sleeve, 0 risk-free rate
results.prereg_signal: close vs (fast, slow) SMA crossover, long/flat, one grid, no re-fitting
results.prereg_trial_log: every one of the 45 variants logged to MLflow before the holdout is touched
results.prereg_universe: 40 synthetic instruments, daily bars, equal-weighted sleeve
